entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to have a bachelor's-level degree in engineering or in basic, applied or health sciences.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a bachelor’s-level degree in engineering or in basic, applied, or health sciences.

deadline.value: The official page prints a day and month without a year (for example 'Fall: December 1 (final)'), so no Fall 2027 date is stated.

gre_subject.value: The official programme page states no subject GRE rule.

supervisor.value: The official programme page states no rule on needing a supervisor's agreement before admission.

funding.value: The official pages checked do not state that all or most admitted students are funded.

notes: This is a joint PhD run through the Chemistry, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical and Biological Engineering, Civil, ECE, Mechanical and Computer Science departments, each with its own track. GRE rules differ by track: the Computer Science track requires it unless the applicant has a US or Canadian degree, and the other tracks say it is not required. TOEFL 'recommend at least' and 'competitive' wording is not a minimum, so no toefl_min is saved. The official deadlines (Dec 1 / Dec 15) have no year, so deadline is Not stated.
